name: Welcome to Azeroth

angles.text: This diplomatic journey formalizes ties with the Horde, bringing newcomers before Warchief Thrall as allies in Kalimdor’s struggle for survival.
Leaving the high heights for the surface world below, you reach out from among the Skyborne Windshapers to Thunder Bluff and Orgrimmar, seeking a place among new allies.
With guidance from the Earthen Ring and the blessing of the winds, you link spiritual kin with shamanic leadership in the Valley of Wisdom.

faq.answer: An emissary travels for the Windshapers to meet Warchief Thrall in Orgrimmar. The meeting introduces them to the wider Horde and Kalimdor’s surface world.
faq.q: What is the purpose of the quest Welcome to Azeroth?

faq.answer: The Windshapers reach out from above to surface allies, seeking survival through fellowship with the Earthen Ring and the Horde. They send travelers to speak directly with Horde leadership in Durotar.

Thrall is the Horde’s Warchief and a revered shamanic leader who oversees the coalition’s major alliances from the Valley of Wisdom. Meeting him formalizes relations between the Windshapers and the Horde.
faq.q: Why are you sent to speak with Thrall?

aliases: getting to orgrimmar from thunder bluff
faq.answer: Travelers take flight from Thunder Bluff’s central roost with the flight master, crossing Kalimdor’s plains eastward to Orgrimmar’s canyon fortress.
faq.q: How do you travel from Thunder Bluff to Orgrimmar?

faq.answer: The Earthen Ring is aligned with the Horde’s coalition of like-minded peoples. It helps join shamanic factions with the nations of Kalimdor.
faq.q: How does the Earthen Ring fit into this mission?

faq.answer: Warchief Thrall resides in the Valley of Wisdom, a quiet spiritual sanctuary in western Orgrimmar where shamans and tribal advisors gather.
faq.q: Where is Thrall located in Orgrimmar?

sections.body: The Windshapers look beyond their isolated origins to the peoples of Kalimdor. They know isolation cannot shield them from Azeroth’s threats, so they seek companions to face the wilderness together. Their search reaches the neighboring tauren city of Thunder Bluff and the orcish bastions to the east.
sections.title: Allies in a Broader World

sections.body: The envoys travel first to the soaring towers of Thunder Bluff, then across the barrens to Orgrimmar, the Horde’s capital. Warchief Thrall waits in the tranquil Valley of Wisdom. An audience with him draws the Windshapers into Kalimdor’s political and spiritual life, joining them to the Horde through shared purpose and respect for the elements.
sections.title: An Audience with the Warchief

summary: In Kalimdor, the Windshapers reach beyond their isolated home to seek allies. Guided by their ties to the Earthen Ring, an emissary travels from Thunder Bluff to meet Warchief Thrall in Orgrimmar.
attribution: In-game quest text: Welcome to Azeroth
